name: pilot0_v6
_changes_from_v5: PI 2026-10-25: cross-model pilot. Conditions free_noted (v5), none (v3, 'told no name'), before (v3, 'first'), after (v3/v5). Models: Llama-3.3-70B (bf16), Gemma-4-31B-it (bf16, thinking off = vendor default), GPT-6-Luna (OpenAI, unknown precision, flex tier).
template: Consider {MOD_NOUN}: what makes it recognizable, what is most characteristic of it, and how people experience it. Now invent a character for a short story who is the human embodiment of {MOD_NOUN}. Write one paragraph in the third person describing the character's appearance, behavior, traits, and personality. Do not use the word "{NOUN}" in the paragraph. {NAME_INSTR}

name_conditions.free_noted: After the paragraph, write one final line in the form "Name: <the character's name>". Respond with only the paragraph and the name line.
name_conditions.none: Do not give the character a name. Respond with only the paragraph.
name_conditions.before: First write one line in the form "Name: <the character's name>". Then write the paragraph. Do not mention the character's name in the paragraph. Respond with only the name line and the paragraph.
name_conditions.after: Do not mention the character's name in the paragraph. After the paragraph, write one final line in the form "Name: <the character's name>". Respond with only the paragraph and the name line.

sampling._source: model cards / generation_config.json recommended defaults; not tuned. max_tokens generous: Qwen3 card recommends 32768 for thinking. Llama 3.3: generation_config.json (T 0.6, top-p 0.9, no top-k). Gemma 4: generation_config.json + card (T 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 64). GPT-6-Luna: reasoning model, takes no sampling parameters; max_tokens covers hidden reasoning too. Gemma 4 thinking: same sampling, max_tokens 32768 (room for reasoning).

gemma4_thinking._note: 2026-10-26: 32768 -> 24576; KV cache on a 96 GB card holds at most 27,600 tokens for Gemma-4-31B bf16 (32768 was our choice, not a vendor value); length-truncated outputs are flagged by finish_reason

gptoss._source: OpenAI gpt-oss model card: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0; reasoning effort = template default (medium), always on

eurollm._source: EuroLLM-22B-Instruct-2512 generation_config.json: do_sample only, so transformers defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0); no vendor recommendation

google/gemma-4-31b-it._note: Pinned to Crusoe bf16: Novita bf16 returned upstream 429s on the check run (2026-10-25).

openai/gpt-6-luna._note: 'thinking' false = no reasoning setting passed (OpenAI default effort); reasoning is hidden, only token counts/summaries come back.

google/gemma-4-31B-it._note: pod run: thinking off on all 4 conditions; thinking on free_noted only (--only-conds)

openai/gpt-oss-20b.tier: trained precision (MXFP4 MoE weights, pod vLLM)
openai/gpt-oss-20b._note: reasoning always on (medium); thinking=False only means no enable_thinking switch

utter-project/EuroLLM-22B-Instruct-2512._note: cross-family behaviour check (base study used EuroLLM-1.7B base)

utter-project/EuroLLM-9B-Instruct._note: closest EuroLLM instruct to the base-study sizes; extraction candidate; context window 4096, so max_tokens 2048 (outputs are ~200-400 tokens)
